Introduction.SourceString: 奥涅伊洛伊是一个合格的好孩子。
Introduction.LocalizedString: Oneiroi is a well-behaved kid who ticks all the boxes.

Content.SourceString:
「今天伊洛伊又请病假了吗？她的年假和带薪病假早就休完了，请到现在感觉已经扣了好多工资了。」
「她应该也不太在乎这里的工资吧……之前听她说，就算让她倒贴钱上班也没事，那个语气不像是开玩笑。」
「好羡慕。看她工作的时候那么认真，完全没想到她只是来体验生活的……」

伊洛伊自幼身体虚弱，无法正常上学。好在她的家境优渥，所以从小由私人教师培养，知识储备能够达到大学通识课程水平。
结束学业后，父母希望她能够融入社会，但她的身体状况无法承担普通工作的强度。伊洛伊主动提出想去社会福利机构工作，于是父母将她送入异象福利院「一意向阳」担任义工，并协助进行部分简单的异象收治工作。
伊洛伊目前的性格深受福利院的氛围影响。来到福利院之前，她并没有接触过太多人类。教师和管家冷漠刻板、小心翼翼，父母溺爱太多，伊洛伊明白这些都不是人类真正的样子。她下意识地选择融入「大家」。
岛上的生活多有不便，条件也比家中艰苦不少，但伊洛伊反而觉得在这样的环境里更愉快，更有「活着」的感觉。
在福利院的变故中，伊洛伊身为义工为管理局提供了不少协助，管理局发现了这名异能者人才。同时，伊洛伊也对管理局的工作产生了兴趣。双方达成一致，伊洛伊顺利进入异象管理局工作。由于其异能的控制力较强，故被推荐加入收容二组。
生活继续向前。
Content.LocalizedString:
"Iroi called in sick again? Her paid time off and sick days ran out ages ago. Feels like her paycheck's been getting docked."
"She doesn't seem to care about her paycheck… She once said she wouldn't mind paying to work. It didn't sound like she was joking about it."
"That's so nice. She works pretty hard. I didn't know she was just working to experience the world…"

Iroi has been prone to sickness since childhood. She couldn't attend regular schools. Luckily, her family was well-off, so she had a private tutor all the time, and she became as educated as someone who has done general university coursework.
After finishing her studies, her parents wanted her to integrate into society, but her health couldn't handle the demands of a regular job. Iroi wanted to work at a social welfare organization, so her parents sent her to the Sunward, an anomaly charity house, to volunteer, where she also helped with the simpler anomaly intake work.
Iroi's current personality is deeply shaped by the vibes of the charity house. Before going there, she hadn't had much contact with others. Her tutor and butler were cold and rigid, always overly cautious, while her parents doted on her too much. Iroi understood that not all human beings were like them, so she instinctively chose to blend in with "everyone else."
Life on the island wasn't exactly smooth sailing. Things were a lot tougher than they were back home. Nevertheless, Iroi enjoyed that kind of environment much more, because she felt more alive.
During the Teehee Bear incident at the charity house, Iroi the volunteer provided significant help to the Bureau, and the Bureau staff took notice of this talented Esper. At the same time, Iroi found herself drawn to the Bureau's work. They came to an agreement and Iroi joined the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Given her strong control over her powers, she was recommended to join CSU-2.
Life has a way of moving on.

Content.SourceString:
对于常人来说，梦境是不稳定、易碎的。伊洛伊异能的本质是将梦境稳定下来，使其成为一个恒久存在的场域，不会因外界干扰而终止。
伊洛伊可以让自己的梦境侵入其他生物的意识，根据对象精神力的不同，能同时侵入的人数也不固定。假如对象精神力过强，可能会无法侵入。无法影响没有灵智的生物。

伊洛伊梦境的入口处有两扇不同的门，分别为牛角门和象牙门。根据需要，有时伊洛伊会把其中一扇门藏起来。
假如进入的是象牙门，则会经历一个无法挣脱的漫长怪梦，梦里充斥着各种生物捕食与斗争的画面，来源不明。
进入牛角门，则会抵达伊洛伊真正的梦境世界，来这里的人可以做一场好梦。在梦境世界的角落里，可以找到一直躲藏着的、「真正」的她。

人们所见到的伊洛伊，并不是真正的「她自己」。
外在的她，只是异能带来的假象，一个接替了原本的伊洛伊，从头开始模仿着学做人类的非人意识。
别害怕，外在的伊洛伊已经作为人类生活了近二十年，她和真正的人类并不会有太大区别，不会给你造成困扰。
别害怕。
Content.LocalizedString:
For most people, dreams are unstable and ephemeral. Iroi's Esper Ability stabalizes dreams, making them constants that do not cease to exist when impacted by external factors.
Iroi can send her dreams into the consciousness of other living beings. The number of beings she can affect at the same time varies, depending on the targets' mental strengths. If the target's mental strength is too high, she may not be able to break in at all. She also can't affect beings without sentience.

Two gates exist at the entrance of Iroi's dream world, a Horned Gate and an Ivory Gate. Sometimes she conceals one of them when necessary.
If one enters the Ivory Gate, they are forced to experience a long and bizarre dream of creatures fighting and devouring each other. No one knows why this is the case.
If one enters the Horned Gate, they reach Iroi's true dream world and can have a nice dream. The real Iroi is hiding somewhere in the corner of this world.

In other words, the "Iroi" people see on the outside is not her true self.
The Iroi people see is nothing but an illusion created by her powers. The external Iroi, after taking over the original, is in essence a non-human consciousness that mimics human beings.
Don't be afraid. The external Iroi has posed as a human for about twenty years. She's not that different from a genuine human. She won't bite.
No need to panic.

Content.SourceString:
异象管理局和福利院的氛围大相径庭，不过伊洛伊很快就适应了这里的节奏，和新队友薄荷、真红的相处也很融洽。
真红的异能会招致暴走，伊洛伊的异能则完美补足了这个缺点：她的梦境能将暴走真红的情绪稳定下来。因此，真红经常进入伊洛伊的梦境世界，两人相处融洽。
但在某次任务后，真红对伊洛伊的态度忽然发生了大转变，仿佛将伊洛伊视作一名敌人。虽然伊洛伊搞不明白其中原因，但本着礼尚往来的原则，她也以相似的态度回敬真红，原本友好的氛围不复存在。
薄荷察觉了两人之间不对劲的气氛，在任务间隙努力地旁敲侧击询问，才得知真红在伊洛伊的梦境里见到了「另一个伊洛伊」。真红误以为，是外在的伊洛伊「夺舍」了真正的伊洛伊，她对这种行为感到不齿，因此才发生了那样的态度转变。
之后，薄荷又费了很大的劲才劝动真红和伊洛伊，让她们面对面把事情解释清楚。得知伊洛伊梦境中另一个自己的真相后，真红意识到自己的推断完全错误，向伊洛伊道了歉。

「在梦里看到一个楚楚可怜的家伙，就不顾一切地想着替她打抱不平，真是一条欠缺思考的暴躁龙呀~」
「啊啊，我已经道歉了，你怎么还在说刻薄话！你这只……天线羊！」
「嗯~关系缓和啦！大家就这样相亲相爱地好好相处吧~」

事后，真红和伊洛伊一起请薄荷吃了一顿丰盛的大餐。
Content.LocalizedString:
The Bureau of Anomaly Control and the charity house have entirely different vibes. Still, Iroi was able to get used to the different pace, and she got along with her new teammates, Mint and Shinku.
While Shinku's powers could drive her berserk, Iroi can use her powers to calm Shinku down in the dream world. As a result, Shinku frequently enters Iroi's dream world, and they got along.
However, after a certain mission, things changed. Shinku's attitude towards Iroi shifted for the worse, almost harboring animosity. Iroi didn't know what caused this change, but she responded with the same attitude. The two of them were friendly no more.
Mint noticed the awkward tension between the two. After some poking around between missions, she finally figured it out. Shinku had seen "the other Iroi" in her dream world. Shinku mistakenly assumed that the external Iroi had taken over the real one, and disgusted by what she thought was happening, she held a grudge against the external Iroi.
After that, Mint worked hard to convince Shinku and Iroi to clear up the misunderstanding. Once Shinku learned the truth about the Iroi in the dream world, she realized she assumed wrongly and apologized to Iroi.

"You saw that pitiful being in a dream and threw out everything to stand up for her—what a hotheaded dragon who doesn't think things through!"
"Arrgh, why are you still so mean after I said sorry? You… Ramtenna!"
"Okie-dokie, problem solved! Let's get along with each other like this!"

That's how Mint earned a lavish meal from Shinku and Iroi.

Content.SourceString:
伊洛伊的异能为她塑造出一个稳定的梦境，但梦的存在需要「做梦的人」，这个人就是内在真正的伊洛伊，异能的梦境是属于她的梦。真正的伊洛伊始终身处梦境世界中，始终在做梦，因此始终在睡觉。
对于外在的伊洛伊而言，她并不需要休息，理论上可以一直清醒下去。不过，睡觉是人类不可或缺的行动，所以她还是会和其他人一样按时上床、盖上被子、闭上眼睛。
虽然不会真的睡着，但在被窝里待着真的很舒服。
Content.LocalizedString:
Iroi's powers create a stable dream for her, but a dream needs someone to be dreaming, and that person is the real Iroi within. The dreams created by her powers belong to her. The real Iroi always remains inside the dream world, always dreaming, and thus always sleeping.
The Iroi outside doesn't need to rest. In theory, she could stay awake forever. That said, sleep is something humans need, so she still goes to bed on time, pulls up the blanket, and shuts her eyes like everyone else.
She doesn't fall asleep, but she enjoys the cozy feeling of being wrapped in soft and fluffy blankets.

Content.SourceString:
最初，伊洛伊的梦境里是一团模糊的混沌。随着伊洛伊逐渐长大，见到的东西越来越多，三只小羊莫尔甫斯、伊刻洛斯、方塔苏斯开始试图让梦境世界变得丰富多彩起来。三只小羊各自分工，莫尔甫斯造来往行人，伊刻洛斯造飞禽走兽，方塔苏斯造无生命的景物。在它们的努力下，伊洛伊的梦境变成了不输现实的小小世界。
至于这三只小羊是何时出现的，无论是哪个伊洛伊，都记得不太清楚。是伴随着异能出现的吗？但真正的伊洛伊，似乎在出生时就已经见过它们了。
莫尔甫斯喜欢耍酷，自称是老大，实际上常常受欺负；伊刻洛斯可爱腼腆，却也有些坏坏的小心思；方塔苏斯呆呆的，喜欢边吹小号边乱飞。对于长期独自待在医院和家中的小伊洛伊而言，它们是自己最好的朋友。

「现在伊洛伊有新朋友了，我们是不是该走了？」
「不要不要，我不想离开她！」
「她在……我们就在……离不开的……」
Content.LocalizedString:
At first, Iroi's dream world was just a hazy, chaotic mess. As she grew up and experienced more of the world, three little kids, Morpheus, Icelos, and Phantasos, started trying to fill her dream world with color and life. The three kids worked together. Morpheus created passers by, Icelos created birds and beasts, and Phantasos created scenery that weren't based on living beings. Through their collective efforts, Iroi's dream world became a tiny world that rivaled reality itself.
As for when the three kids first appeared, neither Iroi remembers clearly—did they show up when her powers awakened? The real Iroi claims to have seen them since the moment she was born.
Morpheus likes to act cool and calls himself the boss, but he's actually the one who usually gets picked on. Icelos is cute and shy, but has a bit of a mischievous streak. Phantasos is a total airhead, always flying around aimlessly while blowing a little trumpet. For young Iroi, who spent so much of her time alone in hospitals and at home, they were her best friends.

"Iroi has new friends now. Is it time for us to leave?"
"No way, I don't want to leave her!"
"She's there… we're there… must not part…"

Content.SourceString:
自出生起，伊洛伊的身体状况就十分堪忧，直到一周岁时异能觉醒，情况才有所好转。时至今日，她仍需要佩戴生命体征监测装置以预防风险。
真正的伊洛伊，其实根本不愿意活着。
她的父母却执意要救下她。哪怕花费重金将她不断地推进手术室，也要挽留她的生命。
没有人知道，早在母亲的腹中苏醒、在羊水中漂浮时，伊洛伊已经不愿出生了。

异能帮伊洛伊延续了生命。异能为她塑造出新的意识，接替那个不愿活下去的伊洛伊，让她继续活着。
因此，异能看似维持了她的生命拯救了她，事实上是在向她支取代价。
「活下去」，这就是伊洛伊异能的代价。

无论是哪个伊洛伊，都认为自己不应当作为人类社会的一份子出生，是理应被自然选择淘汰掉的存在。
然而——
「既然你活下来了，就证明你不是被淘汰的那一个，这很难理解吗？世上哪有那么多『理应』，已经发生的事情不会改变。你活着这件事，比一切理论都要真实，不是吗？」
Content.LocalizedString:
Iroi's health had been a serious concern as soon as she was born. Things only started to improve until her Esper Abilities awakened when she was one. Even now, she still wears a life monitor as a precaution.
The real Iroi, however, does not want to live.
Even so, her parents were determined to save her. No matter how much money it took, they kept sending her into surgery after surgery, refusing to let her go.
The thing is, when Iroi woke up in her mother's womb, still floating in water, she already knew she didn't want to be born.

Iroi's powers kept her alive. It shaped a new consciousness for her—one that took over from the Iroi who never wanted to live—and kept her going.
Her Esper Abilities may have saved her by keeping her alive, but in truth, they've been exacting a price from her all along.
The price of her powers is to live.

Neither Iroi believes they were meant to be born. Both see themselves as something that should have been weeded out by natural selection.
However—
"You're alive. That already proves you weren't supposed to be eliminated. Is that so hard to understand? There's no such thing as "should be" in this world. What's already happened cannot change. The fact that you're alive embodies more truth than any theory, isn't it?"

Content.SourceString:
人类究竟是如何被定义的呢？

在醒来之前，伊洛伊做着一个漫长的怪梦。起初是漆黑的深海，逐渐上浮，然后走上陆地，在荒芜的丛林里为了不被吃掉而疯狂奔跑。
听说每个人都会在胎儿时期做这样一场梦。大家会看着自己从水里爬到地上，逐渐演化成人类，最后自然而然地醒来，迎接出生时刻。
可是伊洛伊在那个梦里，没有成为灵长类。她走上另一条进化的道路，成为了一只羊。
这是不被允许的，身为人类的本能让她挣脱出这个梦。就这样，她在母亲的腹中早早醒来了。
正常的胎儿也有醒来的时候，而她的状况不同，她彻彻底底地苏醒了。她触摸，感知周围的温度，偶然见到微弱的光芒。这里昏暗、温暖、舒适，还有与自己共振的脉搏。原来这就是「世界」，这就是「活着」的感觉。
直到她的世界出现了缺口，她被带离了那里。
真实的世界，这个充斥着光芒和空旷的世界，对习惯了腹中生活的她而言是可怖的。她的意识受到极大的冲击，不希望自己在这个世界上活下去。失去了意识，身体也难以支撑，这是她身体虚弱的根本原因。

异能塑造的伊洛伊，起初只知道自己要活下去。
于是遇到饥饿和疼痛，就用自己的声带发出声响吸引注意。
后来，她发现人们会发出各种不同的音节来表达自己的想法。她渐渐理解了这些音节，又试着自己发出音节，于是她学会了说话。
有些话只是被说出来是不能让人相信的，于是她学会了各种恰当的表情。
在什么场合对什么样的人说什么样的话，也是需要慢慢学习的事情……

所以，这样成长起来的她，和其他真正的人类相比，到底能有什么不一样呢？

——人类从不怀疑自己是人类，而她怀疑着，仅此而已。
Content.LocalizedString:
What makes a human human?

Before waking up, Iroi had a long, strange dream. It started in the pitch-black depths of the sea, slowly rising up, then stepping onto land, running like mad through a barren jungle just to avoid being eaten.
I heard everyone has a dream like this while they're still in the womb. You watch yourself crawl from the water onto land, slowly evolving into a human, and finally wake up naturally, right as you're being born.
But in that dream, Iroi wasn't born as a primate. Instead, she was sent on a different evolutionary path, becoming one of the Caprinae.
This should never have happened, and her human nature forced her to wake up from that dream. And so, she woke up in her mother's womb way too early.
Fetuses wake up, but Iroi's case was different. She woke up with complete consciousness. She touched around, felt the warmth around her, and caught the occasional glimpse of faint light. It was dim, warm, comfortable, with a pulse beating in rhythm with her own. So this is the "world," so this was what it felt like to be "alive."
She was taken away as her world opened up.
After living in the womb, the real world overflowed with light and empty space. It was terrifying. Her mind was shocked, and she no longer wanted to live. As a result, Iroi lost consciousness, and her body shut down. That's the beginning of her sicknesses.

At first, the Iroi created from her powers only knew that she must live.
When she was hungry or was in pain, she voiced her needs to attract attention.
Then she noticed that people made all kinds of sounds to express their thoughts. She slowly started to understand the sounds, then tried making them herself—and that, is how she learned to speak.
Just saying something out loud isn't always enough to make people believe it, so she learned all the right expressions.
Knowing what to say, to whom, and in what context, that's something she also had to pick up, however slowly…

Having grown up this way, how exactly is she any different from any authentic human being?

—Humans usually do not question whether they are humans or not. She does. That's about it.

Content.SourceString: 你好！我的名字是奥涅伊洛伊。当然，这个名字太拗口啦，所以叫我伊洛伊就好~有什么需要帮忙的都可以喊我哦，就这样啦，回见！
Content.LocalizedString: Hi there! My name is Oneiroi. It's hard to pronounce, so just call me Iroi! Let me know if you ever need anything. Cya!

Content.SourceString: 看见路边的小石子，总是忍不住想去踢呢……一下一下，越来越远，直到它掉进看不见的地方为止。你会有这样的习惯吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I can't help but feel like kicking pebbles whenever I see them… A kick it further and further, until it disappears into somewhere I can't see. Do you do that too?

Content.SourceString: 朋友们总是聊起在学校的故事，非常有趣~我的知识，都是家里请的老师教给我的。没有同学，没有经历校园生活，总觉得非常遗憾呢。
Content.LocalizedString: My friends always have interesting things to say about school. I was home-schooled and didn't have any classmates. It's a shame that I never had a real school life.

Content.SourceString: 「物竞天择，适者生存」，老师提到物种进化论的时候只说了这句话。她不说我也明白。毕竟，这是「我」最初的一个梦……
Content.LocalizedString: "Natural selection is the survival of the fittest…" That's the only thing my teacher said about the theory of evolution. She didn't have to explain, since that was the first dream "I" ever had…

Content.SourceString: 太阳当空照，花儿对我笑~
Content.LocalizedString: The sun is shining, the flowers blooming…
I can't feel my limbs anymore.

Content.SourceString: 好热啊，真想赶快离开这儿。
Content.LocalizedString: I want to get out of this scorching place.

Content.SourceString: 喜欢的东西？只要是大家喜欢的东西，我就都喜欢哦！……什么什么？一些人喜欢的东西，是另一些人讨厌的东西？那就让他们打一架，看看谁活下来就好啦~
Content.LocalizedString: What do I like? I like anything other people like! Wait, you're saying some people like the things other people hate? Then they can fight each other and I'll side with the winner!

Content.SourceString: 莫尔甫斯、伊刻洛斯、方塔苏斯，也就是我的小羊朋友们，总会自说自话地惹出一些麻烦事。有没有什么办法能让它们听我的话呢？真伤脑筋……
Content.LocalizedString: My kiddo friends, Morpheus, Icelos, and Phantasos, always get themselves into trouble. I wonder if there's a way to get them under control…

Content.SourceString: 听说在有些地方，羊是邪恶的象征呢……小羊们，你们觉得自己是大坏蛋吗？欸~居然不觉得吗？说谎的小羊，坏加一等哦！
Content.LocalizedString: I heard some cultures think goats are evil… Kiddos, do you think you're baddies? Oh, you don't? Kiddos, lying only makes our image worse!

Content.SourceString: 我小的时候身体不太好，总是住在病房里。那时候，我觉得所有人都应该睡在白花花的床上，床边放着叮叮当当、滴滴答答的仪器。和福利院的同事聊这些的时候，他们吓了一跳，以为是我的房间闹鬼了呢~
Content.LocalizedString: When I was a kid, I spent a lot of time in the hospital because I got sick a lot. Back then, I thought everyone slept in white beds with those beeping and ticking machines. When I told colleagues at the charity house about this, they thought I slept in a haunted room!

Content.SourceString: 你喜欢做梦吗？要不要来我的梦里看看？记得要走牛角做的门哦，要是不小心走进象牙门，就算是我也没法救你出来。到时候，就只能看着自己从胚胎慢慢变成人啦~
Content.LocalizedString: Do you like dreaming? Wanna take a look at my dreams? Just make sure you go through the gate with the bull horns. If you walk through the ivory gate, I won't be able to get you out. You'd have to watch yourself grow from an embryo back into a yourself!

Content.SourceString: 爸爸妈妈很爱我，他们希望我快快乐乐地活下去，为我做了很多很多。我很感激他们。可我还是忍不住要想……如果出生的不是我，而是其他健康的孩子就好了。
Content.LocalizedString: My parents love me very much and have done a lot for me. They just want me to be happy. I'm grateful for them, yet I sometimes can't help but think…  if only a healthier kid was born instead…

Content.SourceString: 其实我一直都在睡觉哦！看起来活蹦乱跳的我，其实一直都在梦游哦！
Content.LocalizedString: See the eye patch? The eye it covers never opened. I guess I've always been sleeping. Even when I'm live and kicking, I'm still dream-walking!

Content.SourceString: 名叫「奥涅伊洛伊」的空壳，在觉醒异能之后，重获新生！其实我不是真正的「我」。哎呀，这样说很难理解吧？总之梦里那个才是真正的「我」。现在正在对你说话的我，不过是一个在努力模仿好孩子的假货哦~
Content.LocalizedString: The shell known as Oneiroi gained a new life after her Esper ability awakened. That's not the real me. Do you get it? The real me is the one who's dreaming. The one talking to you is but a counterfeit role-playing a good kid!

Content.SourceString: 身体。原本要烂掉的。异能，让我活下去。她不是我。她代替我，活着。我自己还活着吗？我……不知道。
Content.LocalizedString: My body was deteriorating, by my Esper ability allowed me to live. I am not her. She lives in place of me. Am I still alive? I… don't know.

Content.SourceString: 薄荷前辈总有用不完的活力和热情，我也好想变成那样啊~说反话？不不不，你怎么会那么想呢，这明明是我的真心话呀。
Content.LocalizedString: Mint senpai has limitless energy and passion. I want to be like her too! I'm lying? No, no, no, why would you say that? I mean it!

Content.SourceString: 带真红进过我的梦境之后，她好像就变得很讨厌我。难道她不喜欢我梦里的景象吗？还是说……她发现了什么吗？
Content.LocalizedString: After I took Shinku into my dreams, she started hating on me. Did she not like what I showed her? Or… did she figure something out?

Content.SourceString: 我和真红的误会已经解开啦！是这只多疑龙冤枉我了呢~按照薄荷的说法，现在我们有在「相亲相爱」地好好相处哦~
Content.LocalizedString: We're on good terms now. That skeptical dragon misunderstood me. At least according to Mint, Shinku and I "take good care" of each other now!

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉小姐的年纪，应该比我小一点吧？她在这个年纪，就已经找到自己想做的事了，真羡慕啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally is a little younger than I am, right? I'm a bit jealous of her, because she already knows what she wants to do at her age!
Hmm… how much further can I go?

Content.SourceString: 提升，应该到此为止了吧……谢谢你帮我。
Content.LocalizedString: This should be as far as I level up… Thanks for helping me.

Content.SourceString: 哦哦，我喜欢这个！谢谢你~
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, woah! I like this! Thanks a lot!

Content.SourceString: 这是送给我的吗？那我就不客气地收下啦~谢谢！
Content.LocalizedString: Is this for me? I'll gladly accept it, thanks!
All you sweet little lambs, listen to what I say… Hey! Listen to me! Don't go causing trouble!

Content.SourceString: 大家，都回到妈妈的肚子里去吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone, let's all crawl back into Mommy's belly~

Content.SourceString: 睡个好觉……骗你的！是噩梦~！
听好了！乖乖待着，不要乱跑哦！
Content.LocalizedString: Listen up! Stay here and don't run away!

Content.SourceString: 没法管教的家伙，只好泯除掉了……抱歉！
Content.LocalizedString: Those who can't learn will have to be nullified… Sorry!
Woah, can I bring this into a dream?

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，没给你留说再见的时间呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh my, I forgot to say goodbye.

Content.SourceString: 小羊们，轮到我们上场咯！
Content.LocalizedString: Kiddos, it's our turn to shine!

Content.SourceString: 诶？你一个人处理不了吗，真红？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh my, Shinku, you can't handle this alone?

Content.SourceString: 薄荷前辈倒下了？没关系，换我来吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Did Mint senpai pass out? Leave this to me!
Heh, how did you miss those?
Phew! I got away with that.
